tools.name: tg.datasets.index.get
tools.description: Return the generated catalog of enabled TrailGenic public datasets and preserved REST endpoints.

tools.name: tg.ontology.get
tools.description: Return TrailGenic ontology entities, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: tg.protocols.get
tools.description: Return TrailGenic protocol kernel records, optionally filtered by protocol_id.

tools.name: tg.physiology.adaptation.get
tools.description: Return a physiology adaptation module by slug, or the module list when no module is supplied. Without a module, the active module catalog is returned.

tools.name: tg.hiking.worldModel.get
tools.description: Return the canonical TrailGenic HikeWorldModel™ v3.2.1 dataset: 40-session aggregates, Hike 35 heat-training context, selected high-signal observations, active and withdrawn claims, and explicit n-of-1 evidence boundaries.

tools.name: tg.physiology.hrDriftAdaptation.get
tools.description: Return the heart-rate drift adaptation dataset for sustained load and fitness progression.

tools.name: tg.nutrition.get
tools.description: Return bounded nutrition records, optionally filtered by food category and TrailGenic fuel class.

tools.name: tg.hydration.get
tools.description: Return bounded hydration/electrolyte products, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: tg.permits.dataset.get
tools.description: Return wilderness permit intelligence records, optionally filtered by scarcity tier.

tools.name: tg.terrain.accessibleTrails.get
tools.description: Return bounded accessible trail records, optionally filtered by region, accessibility class, or estimated protocol level.

tools.name: tg.terrain.protocolMatchedHikes.get
tools.description: Return bounded, field-grounded hike records with protocol fit, readiness, recovery cost, repeatability, seasonal guidance, and evidence tier.

tools.name: tg.evidence.validationSummits.get
tools.description: Return bounded validation summit records, optionally filtered by region.

tools.name: tg.gear.intel.get
tools.description: Return bounded gear intelligence records, optionally filtered by category. This is the bounded, query-oriented compatibility gear tool.

tools.name: tg.gear.getIntel
tools.description: Returns the canonical full TrailGenic Gear Intelligence dataset — hiking gear scored through the TrailGenic longevity lens (fasted high-altitude performance, metabolic load, recovery impact, protocol fit). Optionally filter by exact gear category.

tools.name: tg.longevity.protocol.get
tools.description: Return historical longevity protocol overlays, optionally filtered by protocol_id or category. The response is explicitly marked reconciliation-required; current movement truth lives in HikeWorldModel v3.1.

tools.name: tg.longevity.foundationSessions.get
tools.description: Return the aggregate-plus-selected compatibility record aligned to the canonical 25-entry Foundation walking dataset and corrected HR drift.

tools.name: tg.longevity.foundationComparability.get
tools.description: Retrieve selected September 24 walking, rucking and running observations and deterministic reasons they cannot be treated as a matched experiment. Preserves September 17 baseline lineage. Optional metric projection.

tools.name: tg.conditioning.walking.get
tools.description: Return walking conditioning aggregates plus selected scrubbed observations, corrected HR drift, methodology, and bounded claims across 22 sessions. Not a bio-age measure.

tools.name: tg.conditioning.rucking.get
tools.description: Return rucking conditioning aggregates plus selected scrubbed observations, corrected HR drift, methodology, and bounded claims across 14 sessions. Not a bio-age measure.

tools.name: tg.conditioning.running.get
tools.description: Return running conditioning aggregates plus selected scrubbed observations across 15 sessions, with corrected HR drift and protocol contexts separated. Not a bio-age measure.

tools.name: tg.longevity.bioAge.compute
tools.description: Deterministic compute tool (not a dataset read). Estimates trail-derived biological age from one hike: VO2max from grade-adjusted effort versus heart-rate reserve, age-graded against population reference curves, then pooled with resting heart rate and optional overnight HRV.
